properties.title: Germany presses to make Ukraine aid Le Pen-proof
properties.summary: BERLIN — Germany is pushing to lock a durable funding scheme for Ukraine into the EU’s next long-term budget that will be difficult for potential opponents such as Marine Le Pen to veto should she win next year’s French presidential election. Berlin’s plan is to give the EU “headroom”, or financial leeway, to raise additional money for Ukraine beyond the €100 billion the Commission has already proposed, according to a senior European official with knowledge of the negotiations. properties.title: EPP moves to suspend Serbia’s former ruling party
properties.summary: The center-right European People’s Party leadership decided Wednesday to suspend the Serbian Progressive Party, the political home of former Serbian President Aleksandar Vučić. The move comes after the Serbian party, also known as SNS, lost the October 2026 general elections , ousting Vučić, its de facto leader and the country’s president for nine years. properties.summary: The line, which can carry up to 750,000 barrels a day, was shut in 2014 after attacks by the so-called Islamic State terrorist group, and Iraq and Turkey agreed in August on a one-year arrangement for shipments while talks on a longer deal continue.

properties.summary: Moldova’s foreign ministry summoned the Kremlin’s ambassador-designate in Chișinău, Oleg Ozerov, on Wednesday morning after Russian drones violated the country’s airspace. properties.title: Uganda in talks to host EU migration hub
properties.summary: VIENNA — Uganda is in talks with European Union countries about hosting a hub for rejected asylum-seekers, a senior official from the African nation told POLITICO. properties.summary: VIENNA — Rwanda’s interior minister has rebuked criticism of a plan by five European Union countries to deport failed asylum-seekers to his country. Austria, Denmark, Germany, Greece and the Netherlands on Monday announced a partnership with Rwanda to set up a deportation hub. They aim to send the first asylum-seekers to the African country in 2027.
